Site Reliability Engineer - Data Platform

About us: We are a fast-growing company building data products for logistics customers.

Responsibilities
- Operate and improve Kubernetes clusters and Terraform-managed infrastructure on AWS.
- Build CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
- Own observability using Prometheus and Grafana, and drive incident response.
- Maintain PostgreSQL and SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery.

Requirements
- 5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or database administration.
- Strong Python or PowerShell scripting skills.
- Hands-on experience with Docker and Linux.
- Knowledge of infrastructure as code and monitoring tools such as Datadog.

Benefits: competitive salary, health insurance, and flexible working hours.
